issue.title: 3.9: Un-skip or replace the iframe pixel test
issue.body_excerpt: it.skip at pixel-detector.test.js:115. The skip is gone, or the test is deleted with a comment pointing at a replacement.

affected_files.role: primary - line 115: it.skip with TODO explaining jsdom limitation; either un-skip, replace with jsdom-compatible test, or delete and add a comment pointing at a replacement

analysis.current_implementation: tests/unit/pixel-detector.test.js line 115 contains `it.skip('should detect Facebook iframe', () => { ... })`. The TODO comment says: 'This test is skipped due to jsdom limitations with iframe src. The actual code works in real browsers - test manually in extension.'
analysis.limitations: A permanently-skipped test never guards against regressions in iframe-pixel detection logic. The test is misleading: it suggests coverage exists while the suite executes a no-op.
analysis.change_surface: 1 file. Either (a) replace the body with a jsdom-friendly assertion (e.g., mock document.querySelectorAll to return a synthetic iframe, or assert against a hand-constructed detection object), or (b) delete the test and add a one-line comment that points at a manual-test replacement (e.g., in tests/manual/ or docs/).
analysis.root_cause: Legacy test was written for full browser behavior; jsdom does not load cross-origin iframe src and the author punted. The skip has lived in the suite without follow-up.

options.name: Replace with a jsdom-friendly iframe test
options.summary: Rewrite the body to construct a stub iframe with a known src and assert detectFacebookPixelElements() picks it up. Use a synthetic src URL whose host is in TRACKING_PLATFORMS (e.g. 'https://www.facebook.com/tr?id=1' — but that is a beacon test, not iframe). The cleanest approach: assert the same code path used for img/iframe elements returns a detection with pixelType='iframe' when document.querySelectorAll('iframe[src]') yields a node whose src contains a known platform host.
pros: Replaces the skip with real coverage
cons: Test still relies on jsdom's querySelectorAll('iframe[src]') returning appended nodes (it does)
options.risk_details: Tiny scoped change; verification: `rg 'it.skip' tests/unit/pixel-detector.test.js` exits 1 after.

options.name: Delete and point at a manual replacement
options.summary: Remove the it.skip and add a one-line comment in the describe block referencing tests/manual/iframe-pixel.md (a new manual-test recipe) — the acceptance criterion explicitly allows this fallback.
pros: Lowest risk; no risk of breaking the test run on a behavior change
cons: Lose programmatic coverage of iframe path

options_considered: Replace with a jsdom-friendly iframe test
Delete and point at a manual replacement
options_rejected: Delete and point at a manual replacement (prefer Option 1 to actually gain coverage)

related_open_issues.overlap: If #34 lands first and renames detectFacebookPixelElements, this test must be updated to use the new name. Natural sequencing: #34 first, then #37 (or batched).
